description: Non-material amendment to planning permission PP/25/05112 (Variation of Condition No. 2 (Compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission PP/24/06652 (Partial demolition of No.40 and No.41 Hans Place. Construction of basement, front, rear, mansard extensions, associated roof terraces to No.40 and No.41, to create 7 residential units) to amend the internal layout, windows and metal railings at the rear; Variation of Conditions 6 (Air Quality Dust Management Plan (Demolition), 7 (Air Quality Dust Management Plan (Construction), 8 (Air Quality Dust Monitoring) and 15 (Construction Traffic Management Plan (CTMP) to be revised to become compliance conditions given they have already been discharged; to incorporate minor revisions to the approved front facade. (MAJOR DEVELOPMENT) (CONSERVATION AREA) (SETTING OF LISTED BUILDINGS)
